findings.finding: The fiscal year in progress is modelled, not taken from reported quarters plus guidance. casefile fc.anchors.current_fiscal_year = NT$4,770.9bn (kind 'model', 'last reported fiscal-year revenue grown at the trailing anchor 25.3%'), year_to_date null. TSMC has already reported Q1-Q3 2026 NT$1,134.1bn + 1,270.4bn + 1,494.2bn = NT$3,898.7bn (nm_revenue_q1_2026, nm_revenue_q2_2026, dc_f_rev_3q26), and the Q4 guide midpoint US$53.3bn at the guided 31.8 NT$/US$ is about NT$1,694.9bn (dc_g_rev_q4_26, dc_g_fx_q4_26): FY2026 is about NT$5,593.7bn, consistent with the ~44% US$ growth guide (dc_g_revgrowth_fy26). The engine's FY2026 is about 15% too low. position/core.json notes assume 'the engine takes Q1-Q3 reported + the Q4 2026 guide' but drivers.current_year_revenue was left unset, so it did not. Every growth_anchor override (bear +6%, base +27%, bull +38%) is then applied to the wrong base: base FY2027 NT$6,054.9bn is only +8% on the real FY2026 (below the Q4-guide run rate annualized, ~NT$6.78tn, which the override reason itself says gives +21% with flat quarters), bear FY2027 NT$5,053.7bn is -10%, and the 2-month stub annual rate is NT$5.24tn vs ~NT$6.78tn guided. Fair value, the five-year table, the buy-below price and 'expensive by about 6%' all depend on it; the base scenario condition in table_he.md ('growth of about 44% in US$ in 2026') contradicts the executed number.
findings.where: position/core.json drivers.current_year_revenue (missing; note at position.json line ~526); casefile fc.anchors.current_fiscal_year and fc.anchors.stub; companies/TSM/out/table_he.md (all value rows)
findings.fix: Set drivers.current_year_revenue = 5,593.7e9 TWD (tier guidance; basis: Q1-Q3 reported + Q4 guide midpoint at 31.8; optionally apply the track-record ratio 1.024 to the Q4 remainder only, ~NT$5,634bn, and say so), evidence_ids nm_revenue_q1_2026, nm_revenue_q2_2026, dc_f_rev_3q26, dc_g_rev_q4_26, dc_g_fx_q4_26, dc_g_revgrowth_fy26; keep the growth_anchor overrides as written (they were reasoned off ~US$176bn FY2026); rerun ticker-value and confirm fc.anchors.current_fiscal_year.kind is no longer 'model'.

findings.finding: Price instrument / listing premium. The table's price 2,660.41 TWD is the NYSE ADR US$408.79 (nm_ib_price, 2026-10-30) x 32.54 / 5. The Taiwan common share 2330 (TWSE, IB contract 37928709, read-only snapshot in this review, FROZEN_DELAYED) last traded at NT$2,370 on 2026-10-30 (prior close 2,415). The ADR trades ~12% above the share it represents. The engine values one common share (2,508 TWD), so against the local line the base value is ~6% ABOVE the price, while against the ADR it is ~6% below: the 'expensive by about 6%' row and the 5-year potential row hold only for an ADR buyer who also assumes the premium persists.
findings.where: gather/numbers.json nm_price_adr / nm_ib_price; companies/TSM/out/table_he.md rows מחיר היום, המחיר מול השווי, פוטנציאל בעוד 5 שנים
findings.fix: Register the TWSE 2330 quote as a price source and record the ADR premium as a fact; state in the table which instrument the price is (ADR converted), show the local-share comparison or the premium in one line, and add the premium's persistence as a risk/assumption (the ADR value per ADS = base 2,508 x 5 / 32.54 = about US$385).
